LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 10.3.1 PREPOSITIONS • NEXT TO, • AROUND, • NEAR, • BY, • ALONG, • AFTER, UNDER

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions • next to, • around, • near, • by, • along, • after, under
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions • next to, • around, • near, • by, • along, • after, under, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: How do you describe the position of something in relation to another?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions • next to, • around, • near, • by, • along, • after, under together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Teamwork as the learner works with peers to construct sentences using prepositions and give feedback.

● Learning to learn: as the learner uses the prepositions learnt to demonstrate various positions.

Values:
Unity: cooperation as the learner participates collaboratively in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (effective communication): as the learner uses preposition correctly to discuss position of things and people.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Prepositions are learnt in Kenya Sign Language.

Suggested Learning Resources

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as Hearing aids and amplifiers, charts showing prepositions signed audio-visual recordings,

print or digital stories, pocket charts, print and digital flash cards
